# Electricity Bill Predictor

An end-to-end Machine Learning pipeline that processes historical household electricity usage data, engineers time-series features, and utilizes regression models to forecast future power consumption and estimate utility bills.

## Project Structure
* `predictor.py` - The complete, unified Python data cleaning and modeling pipeline.
* `electricity_data.csv` - The cleaned, daily-aggregated consumption dataset generated by the pipeline.

## Setup & Execution
1. Install dependencies: `pip install pandas scikit-learn`
2. Place the raw `household_power_consumption.txt` file in the project root directory.
3. Run the pipeline: `python predictor.py`
